verdict.rationale: PayPal documents first-class agent toolkit tools for refunds: create_refund issues full or partial refunds on a captured payment, and get_refund tracks refund status. These sit on the same REST payments rails, with durable, verifiable webhooks and an npm-published toolkit that lists refunds among its coverage, so refunds can be initiated and tracked programmatically. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation linking refunds to orders placed through the ACP/UCP Braintree token paths or Store Sync, no named refund-specific webhook event types, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of refund flows on agent-placed orders.
